Part-Time Administrator (Solar)

35,000 Pro Rata + Training + Flexible Working + Enhanced Pension After 12 Months + Company Benefits

Penrith, Cumbria 3 Days per Week

Are you an experienced Administrator with knowledge of Joblogic CRM, looking for a flexible, part-time position within a growing renewable energy company where you can take ownership of varied administrative and operational responsibilities?

The company are an established and growing renewable energy business specialising in the installation of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems for domestic and commercial customers throughout the UK.

The company provides renewable energy solutions designed to reduce energy costs, improve energy efficiency and help customers minimise their environmental impact.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive Administrator to join a growing renewable energy specialist in a varied, part-time position where you will coordinate installation schedules and manage customer communications.

The Role:

- Manage customer records, job workflows and project information using Joblogic CRM
- Handle incoming telephone calls, customer enquiries and general correspondence
- Coordinate solar PV installation schedules, engineer appointments and project activities
- Prepare quotations, reports, documents and customer communications

The Person:
- Background in Administration
- Experience in CRM's
